block_arm.note: The team-match block sampler of PR #1145 on the same table, decisions, scenario count and seed, scored by the same scorer: the second control arm.

control_arm.note: The foundation sampler on the same table, decisions, scenario count and seed, scored by the same scorer. The comparison arm; the frozen binding record is quoted in the Markdown twin, not here.

decision_level_reading: Not applicable: the sampler does not feed expected points, so the 147-fold decision reading of the pin condition is not read.
noise_floor_note: An effect smaller than 1.5 points per gameweek is not certified. This record makes no points claim: its gates are the S1 and S2 bands.

paired_differences.note: Descriptive: the gates are read on point estimates; this interval decides nothing.

paired_differences_against_block.note: Descriptive: the gates are read on point estimates; this interval decides nothing.

solver_profile.note: A deterministic budget with the wall clock far above it as a cap, so a repeat reproduces a fold whatever else the machine was doing. A fold whose solve ends FEASIBLE is still an incumbent rather than the optimum; the reproducibility is of the number, not a claim that it is the best one. Neither limit is changed to pass a pilot.
